english.title: Drive on motorway, fail to comply with red / green arrow / lane closure signals - automatic equipment

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2002

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), and failed to comply with the indication given by a traffic sign specified as subject to obligatory endorsement in Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988, namely

(A)_[a red light traffic signal,]_
(B)_[a lane closure traffic light signal,]_
(C)_[a green arrow traffic light signal,]_

lawfully placed on or near a motorway, namely **(..SPECIFY MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 36(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988, the Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2016 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) See offence document H20368 (CJS Code RT88973) for the same offence by manual detection.
(ii) Where the offence relates to signs on a road other than a motorway, please see document H20370 (CJS Code RT88975 - manual detection) or document H20371 (CJS Code RT88976 - automatic equipment).
(iii) For offences committed prior to 10/10/19, please see document H19107 (CJS Code RT88971 - manual detection) or document H19108 (CJS Code RT88972 - automatic equipment), which cover both motorways and other roads.
